#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const int mod = 998244353;

double cs[1 << 21];
double sn[1 << 21];
double csi[1 << 21];
double sni[1 << 21];

void init() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 1 << 21; i++) {
        cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / (1 << 21));
        sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / (1 << 21));
        csi[i] = cos(-2 * M_PI * i / (1 << 21));
        sni[i] = sin(-2 * M_PI * i / (1 << 21));
    }
}

int multiplyMod(int a[], int b[], int n) {
    int need = a[0] + b[0] - 1;
    int m = max(2, (1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(need - 1))) << 1);

    vector<double> aReal(m);
    vector<double> aImaginary(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);

    vector<double> bReal(m);
    vector<double> bImaginary(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

    vector<double> faReal(m);
    vector<double> faImaginary(m);
    vector<double> fbReal(m);
    vector<double> fbImaginary(m);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int j = (m - i) & (m - 1);

        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);
    int res[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        long aa = (long) (faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long bb = (long) (fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long cc = (long) (faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
        res[i] = (int) ((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return res[0];
}

void fft(vector<double> &a, vector<double> &b, bool inverse) {
    int n = a.size();
    int shift = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_reverse(i << shift);
        if (i < j) {
            double temp = a[i];
            a[i] = a[j];
            a[j] = temp;
            temp = b[i];
            b[i] = b[j];
            b[j] = temp;
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            int w = cs.length / len;
            for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < halfLen; j++, k += w) {
                double wA = inverse ? csi[k] : cs[k];
                double wB = inverse ? sni[k] : sn[k];
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    init();

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    int v[10] = {};
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    int ans[] = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, n);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, n);
    }
    int res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long) x * x) % mod;
    }
    cout << res << '\n';

    return 0;
}
